conditions.condition_text: Wait for the 5m candle to break the 15m range high or low.
This step filters out false signals by requiring a definitive breakout on the lower timeframe.
Wait for the breakout candle to create an overlapping fair value gap (FVG) that crosses the range high or low.
The FVG must be the middle candle of the three-candle pattern and must overlap the initial range.
Wait for the market to retest the high or low of the initial candle that formed the overlapping FVG.
This retest provides the necessary patience and confirms the initial displacement.
Wait for the retest candle to be engulfed by the opposing candle (bullish for long, bearish for short).
The engulfing candle confirms that the breakout is real and ready to run.
Enter the trade immediately upon the close of the engulfing candle.
Entry is taken on the close of the confirmation candle.
The strategy begins by marking the high and low of the first 15-minute candle to define the opening range.
The market must displace through the range and create an FVG that overlaps the range high or low.
The market must retest the initial candle and provide an engulfing candle for confirmation.
The stop is placed at the low of the initial candle that formed the FVG.
The first target is a clean 2R.
